meta.name: just-scrape
meta.description: Search, scrape, crawl, extract structured data, and monitor web pages via the ScrapeGraph AI CLI. Use when the user asks to search the web, scrape a webpage, grab content from a URL, extract JSON from a site, crawl documentation or site sections, monitor a page for changes, inspect request history, check ScrapeGraph credits, or validate API setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从网页搜索、抓取到结构化提取，一键完成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从网页中提取结构化数据或监控页面变化
copy.tagline_en: Search, scrape, and extract structured data from web pages in one go
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract structured data from web pages or monitor page changes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以搜索网页、抓取页面内容、提取结构化数据、爬取整个网站、监控页面变化、查看历史请求和检查 API 额度。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索网页、抓取某个网址的内容、从网站提取 JSON、爬取文档或网站部分、监控页面变化、查看请求历史、检查 ScrapeGraph 额度或验证 API 设置时触发。

say.text: 搜索关于 React hooks 的最新文章。
say.note: Claude 会执行搜索并返回结果。

say.text: 抓取 https://example.com 的内容，保存为 Markdown。
say.note: Claude 会抓取该页面并输出 Markdown 格式。

say.text: 从 https://example.com 提取所有产品名称和价格。
say.note: Claude 会使用 AI 提取结构化数据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search the web, scrape page content, extract structured data, crawl entire sites, monitor page changes, view request history, and check API credits.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to search the web, scrape a URL, extract JSON from a site, crawl documentation or site sections, monitor a page for changes, inspect request history, check ScrapeGraph credits, or validate API setup.

say_en.text: Search for the latest articles about React hooks.
say_en.note: Claude will perform a search and return results.

say_en.text: Scrape https://example.com and save as Markdown.
say_en.note: Claude will scrape the page and output Markdown.

say_en.text: Extract all product names and prices from https://example.com.
say_en.note: Claude will use AI to extract structured data.
